references.text: The same command to fear the Lord, serve him, and swear by his name is found in the great Shema passage
Repeats the command to follow the Lord, fear him, keep his commands, listen to his voice, serve him, and hold fast to him
Joshua exhorts the people to love the Lord, walk in his ways, keep his commands, hold fast to him, and serve him
Joshua commands the people to hold fast to the Lord their God, as they have done until this day
The one who swears by God shall boast, for the mouth of liars will be shut
The Lord declares that every knee shall bow before him and every tongue shall swear by him
Jesus quotes the command to worship and serve the Lord alone when he rejects Satan's temptation
Jesus quotes the command to worship and serve the Lord alone in facing the temptation
Barnabas exhorts the believers in Antioch to hold fast to the Lord with a wholehearted purpose
The exhortation to serve God with reverence and godly fear, for our God is a consuming fire
